instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the updated CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css to match high-contrast dark executive slate & cyan tones.
Ensure all buttons, cards, table rows, tab triggers, modal buttons, and inputs have concise data-testid attributes.
Do NOT introduce light mode or white backgrounds except inside clean print templates.
Keep typography strict: Headings = Outfit, Body = Plus Jakarta Sans, Numbers/Tables/IDs = JetBrains Mono.
Ensure table cells and metric values use tabular numerals (font-mono) for proper vertical grid alignment.
Never drop dropdowns or popovers into transparent containers; always use solid dark surfaces with subtle border glows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all` indiscriminately; specify transform or opacity explicitly to avoid breaking UI layout.
Never center align the app container main layout; retain standard executive alignment.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, badges, table rows) MUST include `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case).
Hover states must always explicitly set text colors to avoid low contrast issues.
Sonner toasts must be used for notifications using dark glass styling.
